thread:
Rae: Quick ops heads-up: new release-train tweak landing next cycle. Please read.
Tor: TL;DR?
Rae: Two changes: priority lanes (high/normal/low) and a small prewarm flow for high-lane canaries to reduce cold-start noise.
Ivy: How do services opt in?
Rae: Add priority_lane and optional prewarm config to service manifest. Example:
```
service_deploy:
  priority_lane: "high"
  prewarm:
    workers: 2
    duration: "10m"
```
Marcus: Safety checks still apply?
Rae: Yes. All perf gates and rollback criteria unchanged. High lane only affects scheduling priority + best-effort prewarm.
Priya: PMs: any release affecting model shards or quantization needs a short perf signoff before high lane allocation. We'll block otherwise.
deploy-bot: Notice: next canary (staging->prod) Wed 11:00 UTC will follow new lane rules.
Ivy: Will prewarm workers be evicted under pressure?
Rae: Yes, autoscaler can reclaim them; we'll emit prewarm_eviction metrics. Dashboards updated.
Tor: When does this start?
Rae: Next Monday; infra pilot this Friday. If you want to opt a service early, reply with service name + owner.
Marcus: I'll add a CI lint that warns if priority_lane=="high" and prewarm.workers is missing.
Priya: I'll publish the updated runbook and host a 20m walkthrough tomorrow 09:30 UTC. :calendar:
Rae: Thanks — ping me or @Priya if anything blocks.
